4 ادقل النَّخْلُ , (inf. n. إِدْقَالٌ, TA,) The palmtrees produced dates such as are termed دَقَل: (S, Msb, K:) or the dates of the palm-trees became دَقَل. (Es-Sarakustee, Msb.) ―
-b2- ادقلت الشَّاةُ The sheep, or goat, was, or became, lean, or emaciated, and small in body; despised and little in the eyes of beholders. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
